name: Grey Stallion from the Pale Reach quest shows its horse model when mounted (#9288)
contract: Quest 175007 rewards item 560260 Grey Stallion, whose use teaches 365260 through 55884. Spell 365260 applies
SPELL_AURA_MOUNTED with creature 379995 and a mounted speed aura. The creature cache capture (2026-09-04) gives
379995 display 141902, which CreatureDisplayInfo.dbc maps to model ridinghorsescadeald.m2.
Mounting must keep the speed aura and set the rider's mount display to 141902; display 0 is the reported
invisible mount. This reads the server's mount display, not the rendered client model.

steps.label: Using the Grey Stallion item teaches the mount
The Grey Stallion aura is applied
The rider sits on the Grey Stallion model
